newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oki Elec slips on grim group earnings.
newsitem.headline: Oki Elec slips on grim group earnings.

text.p: Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd shares slipped in early Tuesday morning trade after the firm posted grim group earnings for the 1996/97 business year ended March, brokers said.
As of 0014 GMT, the shares were down 10 yen at 596, ranking ninth on the list of most heavily traded issues with a total 446,000 issues traded.

On Monday, the major manufacturer of communications equipment announced a group current profit for the year to March 31, 1997 of 7.91 billion yen, down sharply from 50.33 billion yen posted the previous year.
